licence.scope: NASA science data licence (NASA-led mission data), as followed for Cassini__ISS_NAC and Aqua__MODIS. The pages SVO cites (http://www.msss.com/small_bodies/near_new/msi.html and .../index.html, Malin Space Science Systems) and the PDS volume https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds3/near/NEAR_MSI_6_RDR_INSTRUMENT_INFO_V1_0/ carry no terms; NEAR was a NASA Discovery mission run by JHU/APL. The licence covers NASA-led mission data; whether the curve file is marked otherwise was not seen. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

acknowledgements.text: NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material.
